title: Case 002: Blocked toilet at Flat 3, 15 Willowmere Road, Alderwick, ZZ3 2ZZ
initial_request: Toilet need to be removed to clear blockage. Run block lodged by pan connector.
overview: The tenant reported a blocked toilet. The landlord approved contractor attendance, and the initial visit found that the toilet required repiping; the provider advised that removal could damage it because the screws were rusted and no backup toilet was available. The provider supplied a quote and visit images, and the landlord approved the quote. A later appointment was arranged to replace the toilet. The provider reported completion and supplied a completion image and invoice. The request was marked complete and closed after checks; subsequent notes record a system issue that caused it to return to the dashboard, and the request was held while the issue was addressed.
outcome: The provider confirmed the toilet work was completed and supplied a completion image and invoice. The request was ultimately marked completed by a supervisor.
